scripts.dev: concurrently "cargo run --features dev" "wait-on -t 180000 http://localhost:8080/api/health && npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently "cargo watch -- cargo run --features dev" "wait-on -t 180000 http://localhost:8080/api/health && npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && cargo build --release
